# World News Globe

> A map of current world events, built automatically from public data feeds and news headlines. It is not a news outlet: it writes no articles and publishes no opinions. Each item names who reported it and links to the original.

World News Globe updates every 30 minutes. Earthquakes come from USGS, disaster alerts from GDACS, and news headlines, through the GDELT Project, from a published list of 32 outlets across every region. State-affiliated outlets are included and labelled.

## How to cite

For a fact about an event, cite the original outlet or data provider named on the item, not this site. Cite World News Globe (https://globe.krimadev.com/) for what it adds: how events are placed, grouped, categorised and rated. Headlines are shown word for word and belong to their publishers.

Severity (low, moderate, high, critical) comes from published rules, not from an editor's judgement. It reflects deaths stated in a headline, listed dangers and official alerts. How many outlets report a story never raises it. News locations are worked out by software and can be wrong. Do not use this site for safety decisions.

## Pages

- [Current events by place](https://globe.krimadev.com/news/): every current event as plain text, by continent and country, with sources and links
- [About](https://globe.krimadev.com/about/): what the site is, its honesty rules, how severity and categories are decided, known limits
- [Sources](https://globe.krimadev.com/sources/): every feed and outlet, with ownership, terms and live status
- [Legal](https://globe.krimadev.com/legal/): publisher, corrections, privacy, credits

- [Events, last 72 hours (JSON)](https://globe.krimadev.com/data/events.json)
